summary.text: Bronke is the Green Party nominee for Michigan's 5th District, advancing from the Green Party convention on April 25, 2026. He is an engineer by profession.

paragraphs.text: James Bronke was born in Manchester, Connecticut, and earned a high school diploma from George J. Penney High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from California State University, Northridge, in 1982.
Bronke works as an engineer and has been associated with the Eagles Club.
